key_insight: Integrating vaccine trial records with a common data model and biomedical ontologies improved semantic retrieval and supported trial comparison and design recommendations.
clinical_relevance: This vaccine informatics study—not cancer drug discovery—could support clinical research planning but does not establish patient benefit.
method: Mapped 9,147 vaccine study records from AACT into SEA-CDM.
Linked vaccines and adverse events to VO and OAE ontologies in relational tables and a Neo4j knowledge graph.
Evaluated semantic queries, adverse-event ranking, trial similarity, and machine-learning design recommendations.
evidence_signal: Ontology-expanded queries retrieved 41 candidate RNA vaccine trials versus 16 with exact identifier matching; adverse-event recall@10 increased from 0.317 to 0.383, and trial-similarity Hits@10 reached 0.950.
watch_item: Design-recommendation performance varied across 23 vaccine classes under leave-one-Material-out evaluation, limiting confidence in generalization.
paper_title: Ontology-Based SEA-CDM Integration for Vaccine Clinical Trials: Query, Similarity, and Design Recommendation
